dedupe_keys.name: destatis water management statistics public water supply and wastewater

description: Destatis produced the German water management statistics, with tables on public water abstraction and supply (connection rate and water delivered from 1991 to 2022), wastewater volumes, treatment and disposal, sewage sludge, wastewater charges and water use by the economy, which it reports at 12.75 billion cubic metres in 2022. Coverage is Germany. The tables are free to read and download, with more results in the GENESIS-Online database. Caveats: the survey years are spaced, the latest shown is 2022, and the figures are aggregates, not plant records. Simulation uses: supply, connection and wastewater volumes for national capacity planning. Related records: North Rhine-Westphalia water supply installations (data-nrw-wasserversorgungsanlagen).
